competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, may refer to a different refund type, or may apply only to a subset of standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The correct current 30-day full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days from receipt/delivery.
refutation_criterion: The current authoritative policy states a different return window, excludes standard items from full refunds, or specifies that the 30-day period applies only to exchanges or non-standard items.
